Bluedio Legend+ headphones. I see a lot of people all over the internet ask for a great product suggestion for wireless, over the ear headphones, so I am here to suggest one. I own these, and have put them through their paces for a solid year. Wearing them almost every day at the gym (weights and cardio) for I'd wager a total of 340 total "wears" and approx 45minutes to 2 hours per wear. So yes, I have worn them quite a bit.

You're familiar with Beats headphones and the like, but don't enjoy paying the high price? Check these out instead and save . Very great quality audio, super comfortable and the battery lasts a long time per full charge (i'm guessing 2x as long as the Beats). NFC, wired, and get this.. also has a space for a MicroSD card for those times you don't want to go wireless/wired to a source. I have tried the MicroSD and yes, it just works simple as can be.

Skip forward/back on the headphone, audio up and down as well. Very well made, sturdy, but not heavy. All kinds of color options as well, and additionally, these are the higher end version headphones from Bluedio, there are lower tier versions that seem to be on par overall with the Legend+ line. There is a newer highest end line, still only $200.00 USD.

I wouldn't be a fair judge if I didn't mention a few cons:

  • They can make your ears rather warm during intense workouts, however for usual workouts, I have been fine.

  • Every so often (30 or so uses), I may have a time when I fast forward on my phone or the headphones themselves, and the song doesn't go forward right away. It may take a few seconds to jump to the next song. I am 95% sure that's my 3yr old android phone though. Even if it's not, it's hardly a huge issue at all.

  • Doesn't come with a case, some Beats/other headphones might come with a hard clamshell case

Takeaway:

  • Cheaper than most every rival

  • More features than similar headphones that cost hundreds more

  • Comfortable

  • Long battery life

  • Very stylish

  • NFC

  • Great bass, clear treble, songs sound like they should

  • Very strong bluetooth signal, can reach across a basketball court + weight equipment WITHOUT a clear line of sight

  • Wired or wireless

  • MicroSD card slot for the times you don't want or don't have your phone/iPod/tablet available

  • On headphone controls for both Bluetooth and MicroSD card use.. 2 separate control centers depending on what your source is.

I've read Walter Starkie's second, unabridged translation and I liked it so much that I'm reading Edith Grossman's version.

I definitely thought the Starkie version had better comedic timing. The way he wrote it, he formed what I thought were effective punchlines vs Grossman's much less funny, longer alternatives that seemed more like explanations.

On the other hand, it seems like Grossman's translation is much more detailed. There are things that I either didn't notice in Starkie's or that were just glossed over or not totally explained as he wrote. I would imagine Grossman's is probably very faithful, but I can't read Spanish, so I have no idea.
